correctness.rationale: A partition is an unordered pair of cyclic gap cuts, giving binomial(n,2) hypotheses and each query as the XOR of membership of its two cut positions in the intervening arc. Endpoint splitting reduces any five queried chords (even with shared endpoints) to five disjointly matched pairs among ten cyclic positions, without deleting any originally realizable patterns. Independently enumerated all 945 perfect matchings and all 45 cut-pairs; maximum distinct response signatures is 30<32 and exact histogram 16:42,19:120,21:186,22:50,23:45,24:220,25:70,26:40,27:150,30:22. Verified the four queries (0,2),(0,4),(1,3),(1,5) at n=7 give all sixteen patterns. Fixing one cut yields a threshold family on n-1 states and a depth floor(log2(n-1)) binary-search tree; number of hypotheses yields the upper bound. Inspected packaged verify.py which also exhaustively computes small VC/online dimensions and the n=5 depth-three witness. The all-n proof is structural reduction plus finite complete obstruction, not extrapolation of n<=16 data.
